name: ${NAME}
$keywords: Search terms, most valuable first. scripts/build.mjs appends the locale ids of every packaged locale. Chinese users search for 汉化 far more often than for 'language pack', so both spellings and both scripts are listed.
$localizations: contributes.localizations gets one entry per locale, filled in by scripts/build.mjs. The host reads it from every installed extension and merges the entries into languagepacks.json keyed by languageId, so one extension can serve any number of languages.
